item.title: Texas Governor Announces H-1B Visa Freeze For State Schools
item.description: Republican Texas Gov. Greg Abbott directed state agencies and universities to immediately freeze all H-1B visa petitions in a letter to state agency heads on Tuesday.

item.title: Minnesota Somali Activists Hiring ICE Tracker To Manage ‘Mosque Networks,’ ‘Prevent’ Arrests
item.description: A Minnesota-based nonprofit focused on aiding Somalis and other East Africans is hiring someone to follow immigration agents and prevent them from making arrests.

item.title: Watch: Cuffed Migrant’s Icy Escape Ends in Painful Fall as ICE Operations Continue in Minneapolis
item.description: The fall unfolded after a chaotic arrest scene earlier in the day.

item.title: Democrat AG Candidate Announces Plan To Execute Trump
item.description: Democratic Ohio Attorney General candidate Elliot Forhan announced a plan to execute President Donald Trump, following a hypothetical trial and guilty verdict, in a video posted to X on Tuesday.

item.title: Judge Deals Huge Blow To Democrat Attempt To Gerrymander Virginia
item.description: A Democratic mid-decade redistricting effort in Virginia was rejected by a state court on Tuesday, dealing a major blow to the party's chances of gerrymandering House seats there ahead of the midterms.

item.title: Democrats Urge Locals To Call Cops On ICE
item.description: Democratic Arlington County Board chair Matt de Ferranti and Democratic board member Takis Karantonis encouraged residents of the Northern Virginia county to call 911 when seeing Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers in their neighborhoods.

item.title: Gerrymandering: Virginia’s Political Taj Mahal Crumbles
item.description: This trainwreck of a proposal received a strict side-eye from Judge Jack Hurley, who found that the Democrats might as well have held their vote in a dark alley for all the transparency it had.

item.title: Democrats Block Bill To Help Pregnant Women On College Campuses Despite It Not Once Mentioning Abortion
item.description: Senate Democrats blocked pro-life legislation Tuesday that would require colleges to provide resources and accommodations to pregnant students in a party-line vote of 46-45.

item.title: This Exploding Industry Could Cause Major Disruptions To US Economy, Analysts Warn
item.description: America's ongoing artificial intelligence (AI) boom may be on track to significantly disrupt the job market, according to analysts.
